mechanism: Hydrocortisone is an immunosuppressant that may augment vedolizumab's immunosuppressive effects, increasing infection risk and reducing vedolizumab efficacy through combined gut-selective α4β7 integrin blockade and corticosteroid immunosuppression.
action: Monitor for increased infections; consider tapering hydrocortisone when vedolizumab efficacy is achieved; use lowest effective corticosteroid dose; ensure appropriate vaccinations and prophylaxis where indicated.
